_doc: beat_display 里玩家看得到的标签(10-06 C3-2)
dice_contest_by_margin: both succeeded, so whoever rolled further under their target wins: {w} by {mw}, {l} by {ml}
dice_contest_tie: both succeeded by the same amount, so the defender wins
dice_contest_both_fail: neither succeeded, so the defender wins
dice_contest_by_total: the one acting wins by matching or beating the other
